items.title: Hugging Face Scientist on Safety Issues With Agentic AI
items.title_ko: Hugging Face Scientist on Safety Issues With Agentic AI
items.summary_ko: Margaret Mitchell, chief ethics scientist at Hugging Face, warns that autonomous AI agents pose oversight challenges that incumbent firms may be leveraging to restrict competition. She argues that safety, privacy, and security must be built directly into AI architectures rather than treated as trade-offs to frontier progress.
